market_summary: Across all five tracked assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD), markets experienced strong bearish expansion earlier in the session, pushing all instruments below their respective Value Area Lows (VAL) and session VWAPs. However, during the mid-to-late New York session, momentum has stalled into tight, low-volume consolidation ranges above key Session Lows, with all symbols printing RVOL well below the 2.0 threshold. Without yellow RVOL breakout confirmation or clean liquidity sweeps, all setups are placed on HOLD to avoid mid-channel chop and low-volume traps.

signals.rationale: During NEW_YORK_SESSION, XAUUSD trades below VAL (3899.70) and below POC (3978.13). Price remains below session VWAP (3936.13) and below the sloping EMA50 baseline (3919.25), confirming a structural downtrend. Cumulative delta shows CVD -8.92 (BEARISH label), which agrees with the broader bearish trend, but recent slope (-0.47) is flat. Candles are consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 (3888.33) and the lower ATR band (3866.05), well above Session Low (3852.35). RVOL is low at 0.792 with no bright yellow RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation spike to validate a fresh breakdown. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price currently hovering directly at the Gamma Flip pivot (3871.12), with Put Wall #1 distant at 3819.29 and Call Wall #1 at 4146.65. Without a volume-backed breakout or clear rejection at key levels, mid-range consolidation warrants a HOLD.
